qualifier: isoform-specific ligand binding, splicing and activating mutants
name: FGFR activation by splice-isoform ligand binding and mutation
rationale: All members concern activation of FGFR1-4 receptors; unlike the confusables, which centre on FGFR1/FGFR2 downstream adaptor cascades, this theme holds the b/c splice-isoform ligand-binding events, FGFR2 alternative splicing and activating point mutants across FGFR1-4.

name: Mitochondrial depolarization in apoptosis and nucleotide synthesis control
rationale: Members share loss of mitochondrial membrane potential (viral MOMP-induced apoptosis, depolarization, membrane potential) plus regulation of nucleotide biosynthesis; confusables instead cover nucleotide interconversion, creatine and ADP/ATP or NAD transport.

qualifier: metallothionein and MTF1-mediated, broad metal range
name: Metallothionein and MTF1 response to diverse metal ions
rationale: All members are responses to metal ions (Zn, Cu, Mn, Fe, Co, Pb, Hg, Se) centred on MTF1-induced metallothioneins; confusables are cadmium-specific detoxification or HMOX1/reactive-oxygen redox responses.

core: circadian clock control of energy metabolism
qualifier: BMAL1:CLOCK/CRY:PER clock with nuclear receptor metabolic transcription
name: Circadian clock and nuclear receptor metabolic gene regulation
rationale: Members combine the core BMAL1:CLOCK/CRY:PER transcriptional clock with PPARA/PGC-1alpha, LXR-gluconeogenesis and beta-cell metabolic regulation; confusables lack the clock and centre on glucocorticoids, SREBP/LXR lipogenesis or adipogenesis.

name: Retinoic acid synthesis and CYP26-mediated catabolism
rationale: All members concern retinoic acid production, response and CYP26 degradation defects; confusables cover retinol/retinal metabolism and transport or vitamin D metabolism.

name: AKT-mediated regulation of FOXO transcription factors
rationale: All members describe control of FOXO localization and activity by AKT phosphorylation and acetylation; confusables are NFE2L2, p53/mTORC1 or glucagon/PPAR metabolic regulation.

name: PAPS sulfate activation and selenocysteine synthesis
rationale: Members share PAPSS-type activation of sulfate (PAPS) and selenate plus selenocysteine synthesis and UGA readthrough; confusables lack the selenium arm and centre on thyroid/iodide, SLC26 anion or nucleotide-sugar transport.

qualifier: dopamine and neuropeptide receptors, sleep and motivated behaviors
name: Dopamine and neuropeptide receptor signaling in behavior and sleep
rationale: Members are dopamine, opioid and neuropeptide GPCR signaling and the behaviors they govern (drug response, sleep/wake, mating, fear); confusables centre on catecholamine synthesis/transport, feeding-glucocorticoid control or nicotinic receptors.

name: HGF receptor MET and PTK6 kinase signaling
rationale: Members are MET/HGF receptor activation, effectors and recycling plus PTK6 signaling; confusables are ERBB/EGFR, ALK/LTK or generic PI3K/EGFR downregulation.

qualifier: terminal maturation and red cell membrane assembly
name: Erythroid lineage differentiation and red cell membrane maturation
rationale: Members concern erythroid commitment (TAL1-GFI1B) and late erythroid maturation with membrane skeleton and surface assembly; confusables cover heme/oxygen transport, megakaryocyte development or primitive/definitive hematopoiesis.

qualifier: BBSome and ARL GTPase membrane cargo delivery
name: Ciliary cargo targeting via BBSome and ARL GTPases
rationale: Members deliver membrane cargo and receptors into cilia (BBSome, VxPx, myristoylated proteins, ARL13B-INPP5E); confusables cover intraflagellar transport, cilium assembly/disassembly or photoreceptor outer segments.

name: ATP-sensitive potassium channels and SUR subunit defects
rationale: All three members concern KATP channels and diseases of their ABCC8/ABCC9 sulfonylurea-receptor subunits; confusables are other potassium channel families, insulin secretion or ischemia responses.

name: Sister chromatid cohesion, chromosome condensation and CENP-A deposition
rationale: Members cover cohesin loading, establishment and resolution of cohesion, mitotic/meiotic condensation and CENP-A nucleosome deposition; confusables centre on meiotic recombination, spindle/checkpoint or nuclear envelope and cytokinesis.

name: Proteasome assembly, deubiquitination and cullin neddylation
rationale: Members span proteasome assembly, DUB families and linkage-specific deubiquitination, and NEDD8/COP9 signalosome control of cullins; confusables centre on E3 ligation and ubiquitin chain types or NF-kappaB regulation.

qualifier: BDNF-TrkB and NMDAR-RAC1 postsynaptic actin signaling
name: BDNF-TrkB and NMDAR-RAC1 signaling in synaptic plasticity
rationale: Members link BDNF/NTRK2 and NMDAR-RAC1 signaling to postsynaptic actin remodeling, local translation and long-term plasticity; confusables cover dendrite arborization, spine morphogenesis or AMPA receptor trafficking.

name: Striated muscle stress adaptation and fiber-type transition
rationale: Members concern adaptive remodeling of cardiac and skeletal muscle (adaptation, stress hypertrophy, fast-slow switching, myocyte apoptosis); confusables cover cardiomyocyte growth, contraction or atrophy.

name: Adherens junction assembly and epithelial apical-basal polarity
rationale: Members concern calcium-dependent adherens junction assembly and maintenance tied to apical-basal polarity and apical constriction; confusables cover EMT, cadherin processing or desmosomes.

core: negative regulation of T cell activation
name: Suppression of T cell proliferation and Th1 cytokines
rationale: All members negatively regulate effector T cell activation, proliferation, IL-2 and IFN-gamma/Th1 responses; confusables cover other cytokines, Treg differentiation or tolerance induction.

name: Planar cell polarity and convergent extension in embryogenesis
rationale: Members are PCP/non-canonical Wnt signaling and the convergent extension movements it drives in gastrulation and neural plate; confusables cover axial mesoderm, neural plate patterning or left-right asymmetry.

qualifier: PGC-1alpha/PPARA oxidative program with ROR/REV-ERB clock receptors
name: PGC-1alpha/PPARA oxidative metabolism and ROR/REV-ERB clock transcription
rationale: Members are PGC-1alpha/PPARA-driven fatty acid and mitochondrial biogenesis transcription together with ROR/REV-ERB control of clock genes; confusables cover ChREBP, LXR/SREBP lipogenesis or PPARG adipogenesis.

name: cAMP-PKA activation and CREB1 phosphorylation
rationale: All members concern cAMP production activating PKA and CREB; confusables cover CaMK-driven CREB phosphorylation or cAMP synthesis/degradation and dopamine-cAMP coupling.

qualifier: rod and cone cycles and their genetic defects
name: Visual retinoid cycle in photoreceptors and its defects
rationale: Members are the rod and cone visual cycles, A2E formation and loss-of-function diseases of its enzymes and transporters; confusables are general retinol metabolism or the opsin phototransduction cascade.

qualifier: with tumor immune evasion via PD-L1
name: Liver regeneration, hepatocyte survival and tumor immune evasion
rationale: Most members concern liver regeneration and hepatocyte proliferation protected from death-receptor apoptosis, while a minority covers PD-L1 and T cell anti-tumor regulation; confusables are pro-apoptotic death receptor signaling or PD-L1 processing alone.

qualifier: eye, inner ear and cranial sensory nerves
name: Eye, inner ear and cranial sensory nerve morphogenesis
rationale: Members are the morphogenesis of eye structures, inner ear (cochlea, semicircular canals) and cranial sensory nerves/ganglia; confusables cover middle/outer ear, olfactory or retinal cell differentiation.

qualifier: vasopressin-aquaporin water, glycerol and urea transport
name: Vasopressin-aquaporin water reabsorption and aquaglyceroporin transport
rationale: Members concern vasopressin-regulated aquaporin water reabsorption and aquaporin/urea transporter passage of glycerol and urea; confusables centre on renin-angiotensin blood pressure control or sodium/chloride/potassium salt transport.
